split_policy: Nonoverlapping collinear reference segments on separate same-strand local CDS; cannot infer natural fission versus assembly/gene-calling fragmentation. No function transfer from fragmented nodes.
fusion_policy: Different nodes may occupy the same protein only on disjoint aligned query-residue resources; no automatic interaction or cofactor occupancy.
localization_status: not_predicted; gene colocalization is not subcellular localization
hoxf_segment_note: Original 602-aa reference retained. Boundary160 partitions N-terminal PF01257 (6-149) and C-terminal PF01512/PF10589 (213-568); approximate sequence organization, not a precise experimental domain boundary or a FeS occupancy assignment.

ambiguity_policy: Compare only changed non-context modules between feasible best-coverage assignments. Shared cores do not dilute partner differences. Physiological context coexists and is not a uniquely paired enzyme subunit.
node_identity_definition: Identical observed residue pairs / observed aligned residue pairs; gaps are separately reflected in reference coverage. Distinct from full-HSP BLAST pident, retained in legacy modules.identity.
node_score_definition: 100 * identical observed reference/query pairs / configured reference-segment length. Engineering ranking only, not a calibrated probability.

cross_anchor_sharing.credible_core: catalytic_status supported; active_center_span_status supported; local_cluster_complete true; graph search complete
cross_anchor_sharing.blocking_policy: Overlapping fixed-member claims from two credible local catalytic cores make their specific member pairing unresolved. Compare all jointly feasible competitive realizations, including unselected alternatives. Do not impose one gene/one complex copy-number stoichiometry.
cross_anchor_sharing.provisional_policy: A partial/provisional competing core is reported, without invalidating a supported core solely from that exploratory overlap. Neither state proves a physical interaction.
cross_anchor_sharing.nonunique_policy: Physiological context has no physical allocation constraint; two diffusible-pool claims are nonexclusive candidates.
